name: Distorted Distance

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-2-spells.  Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

summary: Space warps inside a 60-foot-radius Sphere within range. Each creature in it when it appears, entering it, or ending its turn there is affected once per turn as you choose (in the game: your allies gain 20 feet of Speed until the end of their next turn; your enemies make an Intelligence save or take 2d10 Psychic damage and treat the Sphere as Difficult Terrain until the end of their turn).
